atoms.text: Hide & Seek is a Language Memory & Meaning Engine, not an English-only vocabulary app.
Core value is structure/root/etymology -> concept -> visual image -> inference -> retrieval.
Visual support must be dynamic thinking-first exploration, not a fixed word-family poster.
Historical etymology must be verified; morphology/transparent compounds/mnemonics must be separately labeled.
Uploaded 36-word artifact is a parent-child morning mock test, not the source print.
Left-side placement of NEW 12 is artifact-specific and must not determine mission role.
Current observed mission composition is NEW 12 + REVIEW 24; it is not a universal hard-coded quota.
Current real NEW 12: environment, rainforest, mountain, planet, desert, ocean, island, jungle, glacier, earthquake, climate, harvest.
FIRST FIND is first unassisted retrieval after memorization, not exposure/acquisition.
Morning mock-test outcomes are external assessment evidence with PARENT_CHILD provenance and do not equal Hide FINAL SEEK.
Language-specific interpreters: English morphology/root; Korean etymology/affix/Hanja-origin/semantics; Hanja radical/component/sound/meaning.
Related-word links grow from prior/current encounters and must not become an extra memorization list.
Build verified root/etymology data contract and interactive visual grammar.
Add first-seen-word prediction interaction and track prediction/clue/confidence separately from recall.
No user-as-QA, no deploy/Netlify/merge before frozen candidate and TAKY approval gate.
